# Modal

A dialog that asks one question and blocks the page until it is answered.

`Zorix.Modal` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<Zorix.Modal open title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Zorix.Modal" open="{{yes}}" title="…"></x-import>
```

| `title` * | `string` |  |
